character_rules.silhouette: authored whole-cel silhouette remains readable at gameplay scale
character_rules.edges: hard integer-aligned alpha; shadow contours may use cool navy instead of absolute black
character_rules.palette: environment grade lowers isolated sprite saturation and maps deep shadows toward the active scene shadow family
character_rules.highlights: white and chrome accents are restrained so they respond to scene light rather than glow independently
character_rules.grounding: feet share the setpiece logical ground and receive a compact contact shadow from the runtime compositor
character_rules.identity: costume colors, face marks, accessories, and pose anatomy remain authored and stable

setpiece_rules.texture: retain authored concrete, asphalt, fence, vegetation, and atmospheric texture clusters
setpiece_rules.depth: cool foreground and structure values frame warmer sunset distance without flattening the scene
setpiece_rules.lighting: characters inherit the setpiece shadow family and may retain a restrained warm rim from the horizon
setpiece_rules.noise: texture is clustered and deliberate; no global photographic grain over gameplay pixels
